item.title: Muddy road, 28th July
item.description:
The current building works going on in the folley on Swindon road are causing mud buildup down a long part of Swindon road. The risk to slippage on this for road users is a huge concern. Daily road cleaners are used but all they manage to achieve is make all the cars dirty and despite their efforts the roads remain exactly the same. A more adequate solution would be the building company facilitate a means of cleaning tyres on exit of the site.
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 369, Swindon Road, Wymans Brook, Cheltenham, Cheltenham
